activities.title: Start Here: Your Fashion English Course
activities.summary: Students meet the weekly rhythm of the course, complete a light self-assessment, and connect English to real Fashion Design study goals.

en.title: Start Here: Your Fashion English Course
en.summary: Learn how the week works and think about why English matters for Fashion Design.
en.instructions: Read the welcome screen, look at the weekly routine, and answer the short diagnostic questions about your interests and goals.
success_criteria: I can identify the main parts of the weekly routine.
I can choose a Fashion Design area that interests me.
I can say one reason I want English for my studies.
sentence_frames: I want to learn English for ___.

pt.title: Comece Aqui: Seu Curso de Inglês para Moda
pt.summary: Entenda como a semana funciona e pense por que o inglês é importante para o Design de Moda.
pt.instructions: Leia a tela de boas-vindas, observe a rotina semanal e responda às perguntas curtas de diagnóstico sobre seus interesses e objetivos.
success_criteria: Eu consigo identificar as partes principais da rotina semanal.
Eu consigo escolher uma área de Design de Moda que me interessa.
Eu consigo dizer um motivo para querer inglês nos meus estudos.
sentence_frames: I want to learn English for ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Introduce the weekly rhythm explicitly: listening, reading, vocabulary, writing, review, and teacher session. Keep the diagnostic low-stakes and use it to frame English as a practical tool for Fashion Design study.

input.prompt_en: What area of Fashion Design interests you, and what do you want English for?
input.prompt_pt: Qual área do Design de Moda interessa a você, e para que você quer o inglês?

items.label_en: How comfortable are you reading short texts in English?
items.label_pt: Quanto conforto você tem para ler textos curtos em inglês?

items.label_en: Which area of fashion interests you most right now?
items.label_pt: Qual área da moda mais interessa você neste momento?

items.label_en: Which English skill do you most want to improve?
items.label_pt: Qual habilidade em inglês você mais quer melhorar?

steps.title: Notice the weekly routine
steps.student_action_en: Look at the weekly routine and identify listening, reading, vocabulary, writing, review, and teacher session.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a rotina semanal e identifique escuta, leitura, vocabulário, escrita, revisão e sessão com o professor.
steps.teacher_action: Explain that the same rhythm will return in later weeks, even when the content focus changes.

steps.title: Answer the diagnostic
steps.student_action_en: Answer the short questions about your English confidence, Fashion Design interests, and learning goals.
steps.student_action_pt: Responda às perguntas curtas sobre sua confiança em inglês, seus interesses em Design de Moda e seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
steps.teacher_action: Encourage honest answers and avoid treating this as a formal test.

expected_output.description_en: Short self-assessment and goal-setting responses connected to Fashion Design study.
expected_output.description_pt: Respostas curtas de autoavaliação e definição de objetivos ligadas ao estudo de Design de Moda.

completion_criteria_en: The student reviews the weekly routine.
The student completes the short diagnostic.
The student names one Fashion Design interest or English goal.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno observa a rotina semanal.
O aluno completa o diagnóstico curto.
O aluno nomeia um interesse em Design de Moda ou um objetivo de inglês.
checklist_en: I connected English to a real study goal.
checklist_pt: Eu respondi às perguntas do diagnóstico.
Eu relacionei o inglês a um objetivo real de estudo.
assessment.model_response_en: I am interested in sketching, and I want English for portfolio texts and videos about design.
assessment.model_response_pt: Tenho interesse em croquis e quero inglês para textos de portfólio e vídeos sobre design.
common_errors: Giving a very broad answer with no Fashion Design connection.
feedback_prompts_en: Can you connect your goal to one real Fashion Design class or task?
feedback_prompts_pt: Você pode relacionar seu objetivo a uma aula ou tarefa real de Design de Moda?

support: Offer a visible list of example interests such as drawing, sewing, patternmaking, accessories, and sustainability.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to explain both a Fashion Design interest and a specific English goal.

extension_options: Share your goal with a partner and find one common interest.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This activity can work as an onboarding card with completion tracking and simple response capture for teacher review.

activities.title: Meet Ana, a Fashion Design Student
activities.summary: Students read a short A2-level model profile and identify studies, interests, and English goals they can later reuse in their own writing.

en.title: Meet Ana, a Fashion Design Student
en.summary: Read a short profile and find important details about Ana's studies and goals.
en.instructions: Read Ana's profile, use the image for support, and answer the comprehension questions.
success_criteria: I can identify what Ana studies.
I can find one class and one interest in the text.
I can identify why Ana wants English.

pt.title: Conheça Ana, uma estudante de Design de Moda
pt.summary: Leia um perfil curto e encontre detalhes importantes sobre os estudos e os objetivos da Ana.
pt.instructions: Leia o perfil da Ana, use a imagem como apoio e responda às perguntas de compreensão.
success_criteria: Eu consigo identificar o que a Ana estuda.
Eu consigo localizar uma disciplina e um interesse no texto.
Eu consigo identificar por que a Ana quer aprender inglês.

activities.teacher_instructions: Use the profile as a writing model. Point students to the sentence frames they can borrow later and remind them to read for meaning before translating word by word.

input.prompt_en: Find the main study details in Ana's profile.
input.prompt_pt: Encontre os principais detalhes de estudo no perfil da Ana.

items.label_pt: Por que a Ana quer aprender inglês?

steps.title: Read for the main idea
steps.student_action_en: Read Ana's profile once and decide who she is and what she studies.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia o perfil da Ana uma vez e identifique quem ela é e o que ela estuda.
steps.teacher_action: Encourage students to find the main idea first instead of translating every word.

steps.title: Find the details
steps.student_action_en: Read again and find one class, one interest, and one English goal.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia novamente e encontre uma disciplina, um interesse e um objetivo de inglês.
steps.teacher_action: Model where to look for course words, interest phrases, and goal language.

steps.title: Answer the questions
steps.student_action_en: Answer the comprehension questions with short, accurate responses.
steps.student_action_pt: Responda às perguntas de compreensão com respostas curtas e corretas.
steps.teacher_action: Check for meaning-based answers rather than copied fragments only.

expected_output.description_en: Short answers showing understanding of Ana's study profile.
expected_output.description_pt: Respostas curtas que mostram compreensão do perfil de estudos da Ana.

completion_criteria_en: The student identifies Ana as a Fashion Design student.
The student identifies at least one class or interest from the text.
The student identifies Ana's English goal.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno identifica Ana como estudante de Design de Moda.
O aluno identifica pelo menos uma disciplina ou interesse do texto.
O aluno identifica o objetivo de inglês da Ana.
checklist_en: I connected the text to my own future profile.
checklist_pt: Eu relacionei o texto ao meu proprio perfil futuro.
assessment.model_response_en: Ana studies Fashion Design. She has classes in drawing, sewing, patternmaking, creativity, art history, and text production. She wants English for fashion vocabulary and portfolio texts.
assessment.model_response_pt: Ana estuda Design de Moda. Ela tem aulas de desenho, costura, modelagem, criatividade, história da arte e produção textual. Ela quer inglês para vocabulário de moda e textos de portfólio.
common_errors: Copying isolated words without identifying the goal.
feedback_prompts_en: Which sentence in the text helped you find the answer?
feedback_prompts_pt: Qual frase do texto ajudou você a encontrar a resposta?

support: Underline the sentence frames in the text before the second reading.
challenge: Ask students to identify one detail from Ana's profile they may want to reuse in their own writing.

extension_options: Compare Ana's interests with your own in one short sentence.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This works well as a short reading card with image support, auto-check questions, and a highlighted sentence-frame layer.

activities.title: Listen: My First Week in Fashion Design
activities.summary: Students listen to a short first-semester introduction and identify the speaker's classes, interests, and reasons for learning English.

en.title: Listen: My First Week in Fashion Design
en.summary: Listen to a student introduction and catch the main study details.
en.instructions: Listen to the audio two or three times and note what the student studies, likes, and wants English for.
success_criteria: I can identify who is speaking.
I can hear at least two classes or interests.
I can identify why the student wants English.

pt.title: Escute: Minha primeira semana em Design de Moda
pt.summary: Escute a apresentação de um estudante e identifique os principais detalhes de estudo.
pt.instructions: Escute o áudio duas ou três vezes e anote o que o estudante estuda, do que gosta e para que quer o inglês.
success_criteria: Eu consigo identificar quem está falando.
Eu consigo ouvir pelo menos duas disciplinas ou interesses.
Eu consigo identificar por que o estudante quer inglês.

activities.teacher_instructions: If audio is not available yet, read the script aloud slowly and clearly. Keep the listening purpose focused on gist first and details second.
materials: audio clip or teacher read-aloud script

input.prompt_en: Listen and identify the speaker's classes, interests, and English goals.
input.prompt_pt: Escute e identifique as disciplinas, os interesses e os objetivos de inglês do falante.

items.label_en: Which classes does the student mention?
Why does the student want English?
items.label_pt: Por que o estudante quer aprender inglês?

steps.title: Listen for the big picture
steps.student_action_en: Listen once and decide who is speaking and what they study.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute uma vez e identifique quem está falando e o que essa pessoa estuda.
steps.teacher_action: Set a clear purpose before the first play and keep students focused on gist.

steps.title: Listen for details
steps.student_action_en: Listen again and note classes, interests, and one reason for learning English.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute novamente e anote disciplinas, interesses e um motivo para aprender inglês.
steps.teacher_action: Allow a short pause between plays if learners need extra support.

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.student_action_en: Answer the listening questions using short notes or short sentences.
steps.student_action_pt: Responda às perguntas de escuta usando anotações curtas ou frases curtas.
steps.teacher_action: Confirm that students are using meaning-based answers, not random isolated words.

expected_output.description_en: Short listening answers that show the student understood the main details.
expected_output.description_pt: Respostas curtas de escuta que mostram que o aluno entendeu os detalhes principais.

completion_criteria_en: The student identifies the speaker as a Fashion Design student.
The student identifies at least two accurate details.
The student identifies one reason for learning English.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno identifica o falante como estudante de Design de Moda.
O aluno identifica pelo menos dois detalhes corretos.
O aluno identifica um motivo para aprender inglês.
checklist_en: I listened for the main idea.
I checked my answers after listening.
checklist_pt: Eu escutei para entender a ideia principal.
Eu escutei novamente para identificar detalhes.
Eu conferi minhas respostas depois da escuta.
assessment.model_response_en: The speaker studies Fashion Design, likes sketching garments and working with fabric, and wants English for fashion vocabulary, portfolio texts, and simple videos.
assessment.model_response_pt: O falante estuda Design de Moda, gosta de fazer croquis de roupas e trabalhar com tecido, e quer inglês para vocabulário de moda, textos de portfólio e vídeos simples.
common_errors: Missing the reason for learning English.
feedback_prompts_en: Which words helped you identify the student's goal?
feedback_prompts_pt: Quais palavras ajudaram você a identificar o objetivo do estudante?

support: Provide a small visible keyword bank before the second listen.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to paraphrase one detail instead of repeating exact words.

extension_options: Use one sentence from the audio as a pronunciation model for the teacher session.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This activity needs audio playback, replay support, and a transcript fallback revealed after the attempt.

activities.title: Fashion Student Vocabulary Starter
activities.summary: Students build their first Fashion Design vocabulary bank through image matching, Portuguese-English support, and simple sentence-frame practice.

en.title: Fashion Student Vocabulary Starter
en.summary: Match key Fashion Design words to images and use them in short phrases.
en.instructions: Look at the images, match the words to the correct visuals, and complete the short sentence frames.
success_criteria: I can match key Fashion Design words to images.
I can connect English words to Portuguese support.
I can use some of the words in short sentences.

pt.title: Vocabulário Inicial do Estudante de Moda
pt.summary: Associe palavras importantes de Design de Moda a imagens e use-as em frases curtas.
pt.instructions: Observe as imagens, associe as palavras aos visuais corretos e complete as frases curtas.
success_criteria: Eu consigo associar palavras importantes de Design de Moda a imagens.
Eu consigo relacionar palavras em inglês ao apoio em português.
Eu consigo usar algumas palavras em frases curtas.

activities.teacher_instructions: Treat this as the first reusable vocabulary bank of the course. Keep the terms visible because students will need them for the writing task and live session.

input.prompt_en: Match the Fashion Design words to the correct images and complete the sentence frames.
input.prompt_pt: Associe as palavras de Design de Moda às imagens corretas e complete as frases-modelo.

items.label_pt: Associe inglês e apoio em português

steps.title: Notice the visuals
steps.student_action_en: Look at the images and say what type of fashion object or study area each one shows.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe as imagens e diga que tipo de objeto de moda ou área de estudo cada uma mostra.
steps.teacher_action: Model one or two examples before students match independently.

steps.title: Match the words
steps.student_action_en: Match the English words to the correct images and Portuguese support.
steps.student_action_pt: Associe as palavras em inglês às imagens corretas e ao apoio em português.
steps.teacher_action: Check that students distinguish study areas like sewing and patternmaking from objects like sketch and garment.

steps.title: Use the words in phrases
steps.student_action_en: Complete short sentence frames with the new vocabulary.
steps.student_action_pt: Complete frases curtas com o novo vocabulário.
steps.teacher_action: Encourage students to choose words they may reuse in the profile task.

expected_output.description_en: A completed starter vocabulary practice set with image matching and short phrases.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma atividade de vocabulário inicial concluída com associação de imagens e frases curtas.
expected_output.length_or_format: Matching set plus 3 to 4 short phrase completions

completion_criteria_en: The student matches key words to the correct images.
The student connects English vocabulary to Portuguese support.
The student completes short sentence frames with relevant words.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno associa palavras importantes as imagens corretas.
O aluno relaciona o vocabulário em inglês ao apoio em português.
O aluno completa frases curtas com palavras relevantes.
checklist_en: I used the words in short phrases.
checklist_pt: Eu usei as palavras em frases curtas.
assessment.model_response_en: This is a sketch. I study Fashion Design. I like sewing. I want English for my portfolio.
assessment.model_response_pt: Este é um croqui. Eu estudo Design de Moda. Eu gosto de costura. Eu quero inglês para o meu portfólio.
common_errors: Using a Portuguese translation in place of the English target word.
feedback_prompts_en: Which word do you want to reuse in your profile writing?
feedback_prompts_pt: Qual palavra você quer reutilizar na escrita do seu perfil?

support: Reduce the active set to six core words before expanding to the full group.
challenge: Ask students to sort the words into study areas, objects, and future professional goals.

extension_options: Choose three words from the set and say one short sentence about your interests.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This activity should support image matching, PT-EN bridging, and sentence-frame practice in a mobile-friendly layout.

activities.title: Build Your Fashion Student Profile
activities.summary: Students produce the first reusable written artifact of the course: a short profile about who they are, what they study, and why they want English for Fashion Design.

en.title: Build Your Fashion Student Profile
en.summary: Write a short profile about yourself as a Fashion Design student.
en.instructions: Use the sentence frames and Week 1 vocabulary to write 50 to 80 words about who you are, what you study, what you like, and why you want English.
success_criteria: I write about my studies and interests.
I include one reason I want English.
I use at least three Fashion Design words.
My profile is clear enough for a teacher or classmate to understand.
sentence_frames: I am a Fashion Design student.
This semester, I have classes in ___.
I want to learn English for ___.

pt.title: Monte o seu perfil de estudante de Moda
pt.summary: Escreva um perfil curto sobre você como estudante de Design de Moda.
pt.instructions: Use as frases-modelo e o vocabulário da Semana 1 para escrever de 50 a 80 palavras sobre quem você é, o que estuda, do que gosta e por que quer aprender inglês.
success_criteria: Eu escrevo sobre meus estudos e interesses.
Eu incluo um motivo para querer aprender inglês.
Eu uso pelo menos tres palavras de Design de Moda.
Meu perfil está claro o suficiente para um professor ou colega entender.
sentence_frames: I am a Fashion Design student.
This semester, I have classes in ___.
I want to learn English for ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Model a short profile before students write. Prioritize meaning, sentence control, and relevant fashion vocabulary over perfect accuracy.

input.prompt_en: Write a short Fashion Design student profile in English.
input.prompt_pt: Escreva um perfil curto de estudante de Design de Moda em inglês.

items.label_en: Include your identity, interests, classes, and English goal.
items.label_pt: Inclua sua identidade, seus interesses, suas disciplinas e seu objetivo de inglês.

steps.title: Plan your details
steps.student_action_en: Choose your study identity, classes, interests, and English goal before writing.
steps.student_action_pt: Escolha sua identidade de estudo, suas disciplinas, seus interesses e seu objetivo de inglês antes de escrever.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to keep the details realistic and connected to Fashion Design study.

steps.title: Write the profile
steps.student_action_en: Use the sentence frames to write your 50 to 80 word profile in English.
steps.student_action_pt: Use as frases-modelo para escrever seu perfil de 50 a 80 palavras em inglês.
steps.teacher_action: Circulate and help with missing verbs, article use, and clear vocabulary choices when they block meaning.

steps.title: Check one sentence
steps.student_action_en: Read your profile again and improve one sentence before you submit it.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia seu perfil novamente e melhore uma frase antes de enviá-lo.
steps.teacher_action: Ask students to check sentence starts, verb use, and whether their English goal is clear.

expected_output.description_en: A short self-introduction profile connected to Fashion Design study.
expected_output.description_pt: Um perfil curto de autoapresentação ligado ao estudo de Design de Moda.

completion_criteria_en: The profile includes identity, study context, interests, and an English goal.
The profile is understandable and connected to Fashion Design.
The profile reuses Week 1 language appropriately.
completion_criteria_pt: O perfil inclui identidade, contexto de estudo, interesses e um objetivo de inglês.
O perfil é compreensível e conectado ao Design de Moda.
O perfil reutiliza adequadamente a linguagem da Semana 1.
checklist_en: I used at least three Fashion Design words.
I improved one sentence before submitting.
checklist_pt: Eu usei pelo menos tres palavras de Design de Moda.
Eu incluí um objetivo de inglês.
Eu melhorei uma frase antes de enviar.

rubric.excellent_en: The profile clearly includes identity, classes or study context, interests, and an English goal.
rubric.excellent_pt: O perfil inclui claramente identidade, disciplinas ou contexto de estudo, interesses e um objetivo de inglês.
rubric.satisfactory_en: The profile includes most required elements, but one detail may be brief or unclear.
rubric.satisfactory_pt: O perfil inclui a maior parte dos elementos exigidos, mas um detalhe pode estar breve ou pouco claro.
rubric.needs_work_en: The profile is missing important information or does not stay connected to the task.
rubric.needs_work_pt: O perfil está sem informações importantes ou não se mantém conectado à tarefa.

rubric.excellent_en: The profile is easy to understand and uses Week 1 sentence frames effectively.
rubric.excellent_pt: O perfil é fácil de entender e usa bem as frases-modelo da Semana 1.
rubric.satisfactory_en: The profile is mostly understandable and uses some target phrases correctly.
rubric.satisfactory_pt: O perfil é em grande parte compreensível e usa algumas frases-alvo corretamente.
rubric.needs_work_en: The profile needs clearer sentence control or more accurate use of the target phrases.
rubric.needs_work_pt: O perfil precisa de mais controle nas frases ou de uso mais preciso das frases-alvo.

rubric.excellent_en: The profile uses several relevant Fashion Design words naturally.
rubric.excellent_pt: O perfil usa várias palavras relevantes de Design de Moda de forma natural.
rubric.satisfactory_en: The profile uses some relevant Fashion Design vocabulary.
rubric.satisfactory_pt: O perfil usa algum vocabulário relevante de Design de Moda.
rubric.needs_work_en: The profile needs more accurate or more specific Fashion Design vocabulary.
rubric.needs_work_pt: O perfil precisa de vocabulário de Design de Moda mais preciso ou mais específico.

assessment.model_response_en: My name is Mariana. I am a Fashion Design student at university in Brazil. This semester, I have classes in drawing, sewing, patternmaking, creativity, and text production. I like sketching garments and working with fabric. I am interested in sustainable fashion. I want to learn English for fashion vocabulary, portfolio texts, and simple design videos.
assessment.model_response_pt: Meu nome é Mariana. Eu sou estudante de Design de Moda em uma universidade no Brasil. Neste semestre, eu tenho aulas de desenho, costura, modelagem, criatividade e produção textual. Eu gosto de fazer croquis de roupas e trabalhar com tecido. Tenho interesse em moda sustentável. Quero aprender inglês para vocabulário de moda, textos de portfólio e vídeos simples de design.
common_errors: Missing the verb in I am.
Using Portuguese word order in English sentences.
Writing a very general goal with no Fashion Design context.
feedback_prompts_en: Can you add one clearer Fashion Design detail?
Can you improve one sentence with I am, I study, or I want to?
feedback_prompts_pt: Você pode acrescentar um detalhe mais claro de Design de Moda?
Você pode melhorar uma frase usando I am, I study ou I want to?

support: Allow students to build the profile from a sentence bank before writing independently.
challenge: Invite students to add one sentence about a future design area such as accessories, styling, or sustainability.

extension_options: Turn the written profile into a 20 to 30 second spoken introduction for the live session.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This needs a text-entry component with saved drafts, sentence-frame support, teacher visibility, and simple rubric display.

activities.title: Review and Improve One Sentence
activities.summary: Students begin the course correction habit by reviewing a common Week 1 sentence problem and saving one improved version.

en.title: Review and Improve One Sentence
en.summary: Look at a corrected sentence and write the improved version clearly.
en.instructions: Choose one correction card, study the model, and rewrite the improved sentence in English.
success_criteria: I can identify one problem in a sentence.
I can rewrite one sentence more clearly.
I can use the correction to improve my own writing.
sentence_frames: I am a Fashion Design student.

pt.title: Revise e melhore uma frase
pt.summary: Observe uma frase corrigida e escreva a versão melhorada com clareza.
pt.instructions: Escolha um cartão de correção, observe o modelo e reescreva a frase melhorada em inglês.
success_criteria: Eu consigo identificar um problema em uma frase.
Eu consigo reescrever uma frase com mais clareza.
Eu consigo usar a correção para melhorar minha própria escrita.
sentence_frames: I am a Fashion Design student.

activities.teacher_instructions: Use common Week 1 errors that students are likely to produce. Keep the focus narrow: one corrected sentence and one clear reason for the change.

input.prompt_en: Rewrite one corrected Week 1 sentence clearly and accurately.
input.prompt_pt: Reescreva com clareza e precisão uma frase corrigida da Semana 1.

items.label_en: I am fashion design student. -> I am a Fashion Design student.
items.label_pt: I am fashion design student. -> I am a Fashion Design student.

items.label_en: I want learn English. -> I want to learn English.
items.label_pt: I want learn English. -> I want to learn English.

items.label_en: I interested in sewing. -> I am interested in sewing.
items.label_pt: I interested in sewing. -> I am interested in sewing.

steps.title: Choose a correction card
steps.student_action_en: Read the original sentence and the corrected model.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia a frase original e o modelo corrigido.
steps.teacher_action: Explain the error focus briefly: missing article, missing verb, or infinitive after want.

steps.title: Rewrite the sentence
steps.student_action_en: Write the improved version of the sentence clearly in English.
steps.student_action_pt: Escreva a versão melhorada da frase com clareza em inglês.
steps.teacher_action: Ask students to notice how the correction can help their own profile writing.

steps.title: Connect the correction to your work
steps.student_action_en: Check whether your own profile needs the same correction.
steps.student_action_pt: Confira se o seu próprio perfil precisa da mesma correção.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to edit one sentence in their profile if needed.

expected_output.description_en: One corrected and rewritten Week 1 sentence.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma frase da Semana 1 corrigida e reescrita.

completion_criteria_en: The student chooses one correction card.
The student rewrites the sentence accurately.
The student checks whether the same issue appears in their own writing.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno escolhe um cartão de correção.
O aluno reescreve a frase corretamente.
O aluno verifica se o mesmo problema aparece na propria escrita.
checklist_en: I checked my own profile for the same problem.
checklist_pt: Eu verifiquei meu proprio perfil para o mesmo problema.
assessment.model_response_en: I am a Fashion Design student.
assessment.model_response_pt: I am a Fashion Design student.
common_errors: Copying the original incorrect sentence again.
Improving the sentence but keeping one target error.
feedback_prompts_en: Can you use the same correction in your own profile?
feedback_prompts_pt: Você pode usar a mesma correção no seu próprio perfil?

support: Limit the choice to two correction cards instead of three.
challenge: Ask students to explain the correction rule in simple language.

extension_options: Revise one additional sentence from your profile using the same grammar pattern.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This should work as a correction card plus saved mini-revision step linked back to the writing task.

activities.title: Teacher Session: Introductions and Course Routine
activities.summary: Students bring the week together in a teacher-led session focused on course rhythm, pronunciation, oral self-introduction, and one simple feedback move.

en.title: Teacher Session: Introductions and Course Routine
en.summary: Practice pronunciation, introduce yourself, and use your Week 1 profile in a live session.
en.instructions: Bring your profile, practice the key words, and give a short spoken introduction using the Week 1 sentence frames.
success_criteria: I can say a short introduction with support.
I can pronounce some key Fashion Design words clearly.
I can listen to one classmate and respond with a simple positive comment or question.
sentence_frames: I am a Fashion Design student.
I want to learn English for ___.

pt.title: Sessão com o professor: apresentações e rotina do curso
pt.summary: Pratique pronúncia, apresente-se e use o seu perfil da Semana 1 em uma sessão ao vivo.
pt.instructions: Leve o seu perfil, pratique as palavras principais e faça uma apresentação oral curta usando as frases-modelo da Semana 1.
success_criteria: Eu consigo fazer uma apresentação curta com apoio.
Eu consigo pronunciar algumas palavras importantes de Moda com clareza.
Eu consigo ouvir um colega e responder com um comentário positivo curto ou uma pergunta.
sentence_frames: I am a Fashion Design student.
I want to learn English for ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Use the live session to reinforce confidence, pronunciation, and course navigation. Students may read from their profile first, then try a more natural version. Include one very light feedback phrase so critique language begins gently without turning Week 1 into a full critique lesson.

input.prompt_en: Use your Week 1 profile to introduce yourself in the teacher session.
input.prompt_pt: Use o seu perfil da Semana 1 para se apresentar na sessão com o professor.

items.label_en: Say your name, your study area, one interest, and one English goal.
items.label_pt: Diga o seu nome, sua área de estudo, um interesse e um objetivo de inglês.

items.label_en: Respond to one classmate with a simple comment or question.
items.label_pt: Responda a um colega com um comentário simples ou uma pergunta.

steps.title: Review the course rhythm
steps.student_action_en: Listen to the teacher's explanation of how the weekly routine works and ask questions if needed.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute a explicação do professor sobre como a rotina semanal funciona e faça perguntas se necessário.
steps.teacher_action: Reinforce the weekly cycle and confirm that students know where to find tasks and feedback.

steps.title: Pronunciation clinic
steps.student_action_en: Repeat and practice key Week 1 words such as fashion design, sketch, fabric, garment, sewing, patternmaking, studio, and portfolio.
steps.student_action_pt: Repita e pratique palavras importantes da Semana 1 como fashion design, sketch, fabric, garment, sewing, patternmaking, studio e portfólio.
steps.teacher_action: Model the words slowly, then in natural connected speech.

steps.title: Guided introductions
steps.student_action_en: Use your profile to introduce yourself in 3 to 5 sentences.
steps.student_action_pt: Use o seu perfil para se apresentar em 3 a 5 frases.
steps.teacher_action: Allow students to read first if needed, then invite more natural delivery on a second try.

steps.title: Mini response and wrap-up
steps.student_action_en: Listen to one classmate and respond with a short positive comment or one simple question.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute um colega e responda com um comentário positivo curto ou uma pergunta simples.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the tone supportive and preview Week 2: The Fashion Studio.

expected_output.description_en: A short spoken introduction plus one simple response to a classmate.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma autoapresentação oral curta mais uma resposta simples a um colega.
expected_output.length_or_format: 20 to 40 seconds speaking plus one short response

completion_criteria_en: The student gives a short oral introduction using support.
The student's key Fashion Design words are understandable.
The student responds to one peer with a simple comment or question.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno faz uma apresentação oral curta com apoio.
As palavras principais de Moda do aluno são compreensíveis.
O aluno responde a um colega com um comentário simples ou uma pergunta.
assessment.model_response_en: My name is Julia. I am a Fashion Design student. I like sketching and fabric work. I am interested in accessories. I want to learn English for portfolio texts.
assessment.model_response_pt: Meu nome é Julia. Eu sou estudante de Design de Moda. Eu gosto de croquis e de trabalhar com tecido. Tenho interesse em acessórios. Quero aprender inglês para textos de portfólio.
common_errors: Speaking too quietly to be understood.
Giving a response with no clear Fashion Design detail.
feedback_prompts_en: Can you say that again with I am or I want to?
Can you add one more Fashion Design detail?
feedback_prompts_pt: Você pode dizer isso novamente usando I am ou I want to?
Você pode acrescentar mais um detalhe de Design de Moda?

support: Let students read directly from the written profile during the first round.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to answer one follow-up question and give one simple feedback phrase to a peer.

extension_options: Record a practice version of your introduction for self-review in a future app pass.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This remains a teacher-led canonical activity with speaking prompts, completion tracking, and teacher notes rather than direct auto-grading.
